transcript:
todd: incident-bot fired for 5xx spike from AZ-B -> outbound service calls. Seeing big jump in egress errors in monitoring, alerting multiple customers. paging alex oncall.
incident-bot: ALERT: high_egress_5xx_rate in az-b (threshold 5/min) — current 72/min. links: https://monitoring.redwood/az-b/egress
alex (oncall): acked. i'm on it. pulling logs and route tables.
maria: i'm seeing customer reports for timeouts to external api endpoints. can we confirm if this is NAT / route related or DNS?
danielle: quick note — we pushed a partial route-table change in az-b 23m ago to prioritize a new transit-target for some BGP peers. could be related.
todd: good call. can someone run: 
```
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:az,Values=az-b --query 'RouteTables[].Routes'
```
and paste output?
alex (oncall): ran it — truncated output below:
```
Routes:
 - DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0, GatewayId: nat-03a..., State: active, Origin: CreateRoute
 - DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0, TransitGatewayId: tgw-0b..., State: blackhole, Origin: ReplaceRoute
```
alex (oncall): looks like a ReplaceRoute happened and the TGW route is in blackhole state. traffic to internet is preferred to TGW and failing.
maria: that matches traceroutes; sample from app-host-22 shows first hop to nat-03a then stops. traceroute:
```
traceroute to api.partner (10.1.2.3)
1  10.0.1.1 (nat-03a)  0.5 ms
2  * * *
```
operations-bot: terraform apply for schema change "tgw-route-priority" completed 22 minutes ago by deployer-bot.
danielle: i rolled that plan to make outbound pref to tgw for a subset of traffic. seems propagation flagged 0.0.0.0/0 -> tgw for the main route table in az-b. not good.
todd: paging network team @maria @danielle — we need a mitigation plan. are we able to rollback quickly?
maria: we can revert the route replace to nat as the primary next-hop. doing a quick manual route replace to point 0.0.0.0/0 back to nat-03a. running aws cli now.
alex (oncall): while that runs, let's flip healthchecks — create weighted routing to send a fraction to az-c to relieve customers.
danielle: manual route replace succeeded: 
```
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0abc1234 --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id nat-03a
```
waiting for propagation.
incident-bot: CHANGE DETECTED: route-table rtb-0abc1234 updated at 2061123605
maria: after replace, 5xx rate dropped from 72/min to 8/min within 60s. still see some tail errors but trending down. customers reporting partial recovery.
todd: great. alex — please confirm if any instances were stuck in conn-tracking that need restart or if NAT health was degraded.
alex (oncall): nat metrics look healthy. conntrack entries were heavy but we rotated a NAT instance yesterday; seems fine now. I'll watch for flaps.
pagerduty: Incident-12345 acknowledged by alex. Priority: P1. Summary: az-b outbound blackhole due to route replace to TGW.
danielle: root cause: terraform plan mistakenly targeted the main route table in az-b (overbroad filter), replacing internet route to point at TGW before TGW had working attachments for the specific CIDR. propagation created blackhole.
todd: customer impact: several SaaS customers using az-b experienced outbound timeouts for ~18m, upstream 4xx/5xx saw elevated errors. billing/usage unaffected. legal/comms lead pinged.
maria: mitigation steps performed: manual replace-route to NAT, monitor 30m, follow-up: restrict terraform filter for route-table tag, add plan-time guardrails.
alex (oncall): i'll keep monitoring for 45m and hand off to day-sre at 2061127200. leaving a note: watch TGW attachments and BGP advertisements before routing changes.
operations-bot: created incident ticket INC-2026 and epic "fix-tf-route-filters" assigned to danielle.
danielle: i'll submit a PR for safer filters + runbook update. also will add a terraform precheck that validates TGW attachments present before route replace.
todd: nice. postmortem owners: danielle (ops), alex (sre), maria (network). please add timeline and alert tuning suggestions. cc: @eng-incident-command.
alex (oncall): handoff to day-sre in 45m. I'll post final status when incident is closed.
maria: quick comms: outreach to top-affected customers done, status page updated: https://status.redwood/incident/INC-2026 :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved? current_5xx_rate 1/min. mark for review and schedule postmortem meeting.
todd: resolved for now. thanks everyone — big help. follow-ups: revert any remaining unintended TF changes, update runbook, tune alert to include TGW blackhole detection. :tada:
